##### Source: Dungeon Master's Guide (Spellguard Shield)

*Armor (shield), very rare (requires installation)*

**Specs:** 2 lbs, $$1,500,000

While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against techs and other technical effects, and tech attacks have disadvantage against you.
